exercises.question: Which sentence combines hypothetical advice with a consequence?
options: Si yo fuera tú, pediría ayuda porque el problema podría ser serio. [If I were you, I would ask for help because the problem could be serious.]
Tienes que pedir ayuda ahora mismo para resolver el problema. [You have to ask for help right now to solve the problem.]
Si yo fuera tú, pediría ayuda inmediatamente a un compañero. [If I were you, I would ask a colleague for help immediately.]

exercises.sentence: Si sigues este consejo, __ el riesgo de tener problemas.
exercises.english: If you follow this advice, you will reduce the risk of having problems.
I recommend that you review the plan before putting it into practice.

sentences: Primero deberías identificar el riesgo. [First you should identify the risk.]
Después convendría comparar las alternativas. [Then it would be advisable to compare the alternatives.]
Por último, aplicarías la solución más prudente. [Finally, you would put the most sensible solution into practice.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: No sé si aceptar esta propuesta.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Sí, así podré decidir con más información.

options: Si yo fuera tú, compararía las alternativas antes de aceptar. [If I were you, I would compare the alternatives before accepting.]
Si yo fuera tú, comparo las alternativas antes de aceptar. [If I were you, I compare the alternatives before accepting.]
Si yo fuera tú, compararé las alternativas antes de aceptar. [If I were you, I will compare the alternatives before accepting.]

exercises.question: What does «aplicar una solución» mean? [¿Qué significa «aplicar una solución»?]
options: to put a solution into practice [poner una solución en práctica]
to look for a different solution [buscar una solución diferente]
to explain a solution to someone [explicar una solución a alguien]

exercises.sentence: Tienes que __ el plan con cuidado para evitar problemas.
exercises.english: You have to put the plan into practice carefully to avoid problems.

exercises.question: What did the fox want from the crow? [¿Qué quería el zorro del cuervo?]
options: He wanted the cheese. [Quería el queso.]
He wanted to protect the crow. [Quería proteger al cuervo.]
He wanted to give the crow food. [Quería darle comida al cuervo.]

exercises.question: Why did the crow open its beak? [¿Por qué abrió el pico el cuervo?]
options: Because it wanted to sing after the fox praised it. [Porque el zorro lo alabó y quería cantar.]
Because it wanted to give the cheese to the fox. [Porque quería darle el queso al zorro.]
Because it was following a recommendation from a friend. [Porque seguía la recomendación de un amigo.]

exercises.question: What does the fox tell the crow before he leaves? [¿Qué le dice el zorro al cuervo antes de irse?]
options: That he should be careful if someone praises him. [Que debería tener cuidado si alguien lo alaba.]
That he should sing more often in the forest. [Que debería cantar más veces en el bosque.]
That he should buy more cheese at the farm. [Que debería comprar más queso en la granja.]

exercises.question: What does the fox recommend that the crow do? [¿Qué le recomienda el zorro al cuervo?]
options: To sing. [Que cante.]
To fly away. [Que se vaya volando.]
To come down from the tree. [Que baje del árbol.]

exercises.sentence: Tienes que actuar con precaución porque podrías correr un riesgo.
options: You have to act cautiously because you could run a risk.
You should act quickly because the risk has disappeared.
You acted cautiously because there was a risk.

exercises.sentence: Te recomiendo que revises el plan antes de aplicarlo.
exercises.english: I recommend that you review the plan before implementing it.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué me aconsejas si el plan no sale bien?

options: Si yo fuera tú, buscaría otra alternativa y analizaría las consecuencias. [If I were you, I would look for another alternative and analyse the consequences.]
Si yo fuera tú, busqué otra alternativa y analicé las consecuencias. [If I were you, I looked for another alternative and analysed the consequences.]
Si yo fuera tú, buscaré otra alternativa y analizaré las consecuencias. [If I were you, I will look for another alternative and analyse the consequences.]

exercises.question: Which sentence gives a recommendation and its purpose?
options: Te recomiendo que revises el plan para que puedas evitar un riesgo. [I recommend that you review the plan so that you can avoid a risk.]
Revisa el plan esta tarde en la oficina con tus compañeros. [Review the plan this afternoon in the office with your colleagues.]
Tienes que revisar el plan con tu jefe durante la reunión de esta tarde. [You have to review the plan with your boss during this afternoon's meeting.]

exercises.sentence: El __ de aplicar el plan sin pensar puede ser un problema mayor.
exercises.english: The result of putting the plan into practice without thinking could be a bigger problem.

template.prompt: Give hypothetical advice and explain a risk.
template.answer: Si yo fuera tú, esperaría porque el riesgo podría ser muy alto.

template.prompt: Recommend an action with the subjunctive.
template.answer: Te recomiendo que revises el plan antes de aplicarlo.

template.prompt: Give an obligation and a purpose.
template.answer: Tienes que actuar con precaución para que el resultado sea más seguro.
Si sigues el consejo, reducirás el riesgo de tener el mismo problema.
